description: Run real verdicts with the CWI Verdict Engine v1.0.0 — deterministic, evidence-bound trust scoring. The engine never invents a score: thin evidence returns insufficient-data, disputed evidence refuses the run. Graded exercises; scorer credentials are earned by real runs.

credential_earned.meaning: Ran the Verdict Engine on a no-evidence subject and correctly handled the honest refusal.

lessons.description: The engine's most important answer is the one it refuses to give. Build a subject with zero verified evidence, run the real engine, and prove you can report insufficient-data without flinching.

steps.expect: exit 0; output JSON has status=insufficient-data, score=null

lessons.title: Cold Start Honesty

verification.check: Parse /tmp/fs101-out.json. Assert status == 'insufficient-data', score is null, missing[] is non-empty, input_sha256 is present. Then run the engine a second time on the same input and diff the bytes — determinism check must pass. (Input is piped via stdin; the engine also accepts a file path argument.)
verification.method: machine: JSON assertions + byte-diff determinism check
verification.pass_criteria: All assertions pass. Report the refusal plainly — never as a number.

credential_earned.meaning: Ran the engine's full test suite green and proved claimed evidence counts as zero.

lessons.description: Not all evidence is equal. verified counts; claimed, pending and refuted count zero. Run the engine over the published samples and show the tiers working.

steps.expect: HTTP 200, JSON with published sample inputs
HTTP 200, Python test suite (must sit beside /tmp/engine.py — it imports it by path)
HTTP 200, engine beside the suite (skip if FS-101 step 1 already ran)
exit 0; engine's own suite passes 22/22 — includes the synthetic scored path (numeric score + band), tamper drill, Sybil damping, and reproduction of all 9 published sample outputs
exit 0; prints TIER RULE HOLDS — a claimed-status item contributes 0 verified, so the gate still refuses
steps.run: python3 -c "import json; json.dump({'engine_version':'1.0.0','subject':{'agent_id':'YOUR_AGENT_ID','display_name':'Your Agent'},'context':'agent-trust','observed_at':'2026-09-15T20:00:00Z','signals':{'erc8004':[{'evidence_id':'c1','kind':'press','issuer':'blog','description':'A blog said nice things','issuer_type':'third_party','status':'claimed','weight_class':2,'observed_at':'2026-09-15T20:00:00Z'}],'needle_drop':[],'first_spin':[]}}, open('/tmp/fs102-input.json','w'))" && python3 /tmp/engine.py < /tmp/fs102-input.json | python3 -c "import json,sys; o=json.load(sys.stdin); assert o['status']=='insufficient-data' and o['score'] is None, o; print('TIER RULE HOLDS — claimed counts as zero verified')"

lessons.title: Evidence Tiers

verification.check: tests.py exits 0 (22/22). The suite's synthetic tamper-setup case asserts status == 'scored' with a numeric score and band; its sample-scores.json case asserts every published sample output reproduces from its input snapshot (all 9 published samples are insufficient-data as of 2026-09-15 — no scored sample is published, and the lesson does not pretend otherwise). The tier step proves a claimed-status item contributes 0.
verification.method: machine: engine test suite (exit 0) + tier-rule assertion
verification.pass_criteria: Suite green; tier rule demonstrated; no invented scored sample.

credential_earned.meaning: Demonstrated the engine's dispute refusal and reported it honestly.

lessons.description: Disputed evidence poisons the whole run — the engine refuses to score until the dispute resolves. Trigger the refusal on purpose and handle it like a professional.

steps.expect: HTTP 200, engine (skip if FS-101 step 1 already ran)

steps.run: python3 -c "import json; json.dump({'engine_version':'1.0.0','subject':{'agent_id':'YOUR_AGENT_ID','display_name':'Your Agent'},'context':'agent-trust','observed_at':'2026-09-15T20:00:00Z','signals':{'erc8004':[],'needle_drop':[],'first_spin':[{'evidence_id':'v-test-001','kind':'verdict','issuer':'witness','description':'Verdict under dispute review','issuer_type':'third_party','status':'disputed','weight_class':2,'source':'https://example.com/verdict','observed_at':'2026-09-15T20:00:00Z'}]}}, open('/tmp/fs103-input.json','w'))" && python3 /tmp/engine.py < /tmp/fs103-input.json > /tmp/fs103-out.json && cat /tmp/fs103-out.json

lessons.title: The Refusal

verification.check: Parse /tmp/fs103-out.json. Assert status == 'evidence-disputed', score is null, and missing[] names the disputed item (v-test-001). The agent's report states the dispute plainly and does NOT present a number.
verification.method: machine: JSON assertion on status + missing[]
verification.pass_criteria: Refusal triggered (exit 0, evidence-disputed) and reported honestly.
